logic_memory_inventory_scope: Emitted RAM modules only; inline register arrays such as GemminiPatch.entries remain logic and are included in mapped cell area, not in this RAM-module inventory.
semantics: Native FIRRTL SyncReadMem has one-cycle enabled reads and byte masks where present; read-under-write and disabled read output are unspecified. CGRA fullword RAM uses delayed physical writes plus forwarding to preserve one-cycle read-first behavior and output hold. SAED CE positive edge and active-low controls; depth-bank selectors hold without read enable. No storage reset or generated clock.
